title: Exact mean-covariance dynamics of the Weber field in the stochastic Lagrangian representation of the 3D Navier-Stokes equations
summary: The Constantin-Iyer formula represents a smooth solution of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on $\mathbb{T}^3$ as $u=\mathbb{P}\,\mathbb{E}[(\nabla A_t)^\top(u_0\circ A_t)]$, the projected expectation of a stochastic Weber field.
